- `init` is no longer internal, since its sender is the database owner.
Senders enqueue calls by inserting rows into generated outbox tables, which are insert-only and map their columns to the receiver's reducer parameters with compile-time type checking. Delivery is handled by a new IDC actor that manages concurrent outbox streams over HTTP/2, and optional `on_result` / `onResult` callbacks report delivery outcomes back to the sender. Dependencies are namespaced by name, so a module can depend on two datab

The datastore no longer clones the full subscriber state for each transaction. It records transaction-local subscriber and timestamp changes instead, substantially reducing memory usage for databases with many subscribers while preserving subscription and view behavior.
The new `spacetime auth` command group lets Maincloud users manage a database's SpacetimeAuth configuration from the command line. It supports identity-provider configuration, project settings, and client creation, inspection, and deletion.

SpacetimeDB now rejects JWTs signed with `HS256`. Symmetric signing cannot be validated through an issuer's public key in the same way as supported asymmetric algorithms, so these tokens are no longer accepted for authentication.
SpacetimeDB modules can now declare typed environment variables for configuration and secrets. Rust, TypeScript, C#, and C++ modules can read declared values through their execution context, with support for required and optional strings as well as constrained sets of allowed value

The SpacetimeDB MCP endpoint (`/v1/mcp`) is now available on Maincloud. You can connect AI agents and MCP-compatible tools directly to your Maincloud databases. - Typed `include` results ([#1053](https://github.com/remult/remult/pull/1053)) — `find`, `findFirst`, `findOne` and `findId` return the entity type again, and `Loaded` is no longer exported. The 3.4.0 types broke existing code: a variable holding an `include` result could no longer be reassigned from `insert`, and generic `repo(type)` helpers could no longer index results by `keyof T`. An included `toOne` with no target row is `undefined` again, as before 3.4.0.

## v3.2.0 — Safe capture foundation

The first phase of the 2026 roadmap: make Slower something you confidently leave on in production, and make every capture know **what it is** (a fingerprint) and **where it came from** (its origin). No breaking changes — additive migration, existing config/API untouched, synchronous analysis still the default.

### Highlights

## v3.1.1 — README modernization

A documentation-only release. **No code, configuration, or behavior changes** — the package, config surface, and public API are identical to v3.1.0.

## v3.1.0 — all major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini + custom)

Slower now works with **every major LLM provider** through [Prism](https://prismphp.com), with **fewer config variables than before** — provider credentials move out of Slower's config entirely.

### Highlights
- **Pick a provider with one variable:** `SLOWER_AI_SERVICE=openai|anthropic|gemini|ollama|…`. Any Prism provider works; a fully custom backend registers via `AiServiceManager::extend()`.
